es: Defender una postura sobre un dilema con razones, un contraargumento y un arrepentimiento hipotético.

teaching.en: In my opinion, it is wrong to read other people's messages.
teaching.es: En mi opinión, está mal leer los mensajes de otras personas.
teaching.explanationEs: In my opinion + oración: presenta tu postura con claridad.
segments: In my opinion, it is wrong
teaching.audioText: In my opinion, it is wrong to read other people's messages.

teaching.en: There are two reasons: first, everyone has a right to privacy; second, trust is very important in a friendship.
teaching.es: Hay dos razones: primero, todos tienen derecho a la intimidad; segundo, la confianza es muy importante en una amistad.
teaching.explanationEs: First… second… ordenan tus razones para que se entiendan.
segments: There are two reasons: first, everyone has a right to
privacy; second, trust is very important in a friendship.
teaching.audioText: There are two reasons: first, everyone has a right to privacy; second, trust is very important in a friendship.

teaching.en: Some people say it is safer to check, but I disagree.
teaching.es: Algunas personas dicen que es más seguro comprobarlo, pero yo no estoy de acuerdo.
teaching.explanationEs: Some people say… but I disagree: presentas el contraargumento y lo respondes.
segments: Some people say it is safer
teaching.audioText: Some people say it is safer to check, but I disagree.

teaching.en: Although it may seem small, it can break a friend's trust.
teaching.es: Aunque parezca pequeño, puede romper la confianza de un amigo.
teaching.explanationEs: Although + oración completa, + idea contraria; no se añade but.
segments: Although it may seem small, it
teaching.audioText: Although it may seem small, it can break a friend's trust.

teaching.en: My opinion is simple: I would ask her instead of reading her messages.
teaching.es: Mi opinión es sencilla: yo le preguntaría en lugar de leer sus mensajes.
teaching.explanationEs: Instead of + verbo con -ing dice lo que harías en vez de otra cosa.
segments: My opinion is simple: I would ask
her instead of reading her messages.
teaching.audioText: My opinion is simple: I would ask her instead of reading her messages.

teaching.en: I wish I had asked her first; I broke her trust.
teaching.es: Ojalá le hubiera preguntado primero; rompí su confianza.
teaching.explanationEs: Wish + had + participio añade un arrepentimiento hipotético a tu argumento.
segments: I wish I had asked her
teaching.audioText: I wish I had asked her first; I broke her trust.

choices.text: My friend cheats in an exam.
In my opinion, it is wrong to cheat in an exam.
Cheating means copying in an exam.

feedback.es: In my opinion + oración dice lo que tú piensas. Las otras dos describen un hecho o dan una definición.

hint.es: Busca la frase que expresa lo que piensa quien habla, no un hecho.

prompt.es: Completa: «Aunque es mi amigo, no está bien.»

feedback.es: Although introduce el contraste y ya no necesita but: Although he is my friend, it is not right.

hint.es: Es la palabra que introduce una idea contraria sin añadir but.

origin.text: ___ he is my friend, it is not right.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Hablaría con él en lugar de copiar.»

answer.text: I would talk to him instead of cheating

feedback.es: Instead of va seguido de un verbo con -ing: instead of cheating.

hint.es: Después de instead of va un verbo con -ing.

choices.text: He presents another opinion and answers it.
He agrees with the other people.
He asks the teacher a question.

feedback.es: Some people say… but I disagree presenta el contraargumento y lo responde. Tom no está de acuerdo ni hace una pregunta.

origin.text: Tom says: «Some people say cheating is fine when the exam is very hard, but I disagree.»

prompt.es: Escucha y elige la razón que da la persona.

choices.text: Reading messages takes too long.
Her messages are probably boring.
People should be able to keep their things private.

feedback.es: La razón es el derecho a la intimidad (a right to privacy). No habla de tiempo ni de que los mensajes sean aburridos.

origin.audio: I think it's wrong to read her messages. First, everyone has a right to privacy.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada frase con su función en una opinión.

pairs: In my opinion, it is wrong to cheat.
First, it is unfair to other students.
Some people say it helps friends, but I disagree.
I wish I had studied more.

feedback.es: Una opinión bien construida combina postura, razón, respuesta al otro punto de vista y, si quieres, un arrepentimiento.

pairs: In my opinion, it is wrong to cheat.
First, it is unfair to other students.
Some people say it helps friends, but I disagree.
I wish I had studied more.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase responde mejor al contraargumento de Leo?

choices.text: Although many students do it, it is still wrong.
Many students do it, and that makes it right.
I agree, so I will copy too.

feedback.es: Although reconoce el argumento (muchos lo hacen) y lo rebate: sigue estando mal. Las otras dos aceptan lo que dice Leo.

origin.text: Leo says: «Copying homework is fine; all students do it.»

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué haría la persona en lugar de copiar.

choices.text: Copy only half of the homework.
Ask the teacher for an easier exam.
Study together with the friend.

feedback.es: Instead of copying introduce la alternativa: estudiar con su amigo. No propone copiar la mitad ni pedir un examen más fácil.

origin.audio: I would study with my friend instead of copying his homework.

prompt.es: Completa: «En mi opinión, es injusto para los demás.»

feedback.es: In my opinion + oración es la forma de presentar tu postura.

origin.text: In my ___, it is unfair to the others.

prompt.es: Escribe tu postura y una razón sobre copiar en un examen.

answer.text: In my opinion, it is wrong to cheat in an exam because it is unfair to the other students.
accepted: In my opinion, it is wrong to cheat in an exam because it is unfair to the other students.
I think it is wrong to copy in an exam because it is unfair to other students.
In my opinion, cheating in an exam is wrong because it is unfair to the other students.

feedback.es: Una postura se presenta con In my opinion (o I think) y se apoya con because + la razón.

origin.text: Datos: postura = está mal copiar en un examen; razón = es injusto para los demás estudiantes.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase podría decir Ana ahora sobre su decisión?

choices.text: I wish I will ask her first.
I wish I had asked her first.
I wish I ask her first.

feedback.es: Ana lamenta algo que ya hizo: wish + had + participio. Will y el presente no se usan tras wish para el pasado.

origin.text: Ana read her friend's messages last week, and now they don't talk.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué hace la persona con el contraargumento.

choices.text: It answers the other view and says it is still wrong.
It agrees that it is only a small thing.
It changes the subject to another problem.

feedback.es: However marca la respuesta: aunque otros digan que es poco, sigue rompiendo la confianza. No coincide con el otro punto de vista.

origin.audio: Some people say it's only a small thing. However, it still breaks a friend's trust.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Aunque es pequeño, rompe la confianza.»

answer.text: Although it is small it breaks trust

feedback.es: Although + oración completa, y después la idea contraria sin but.
